scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p . && pnpm -r --filter "!@flux/pwa" exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @flux/pwa exec vue-tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @flux/protocol exec tsc --noEmit false --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir node_modules/.tsc-dts
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flux/protocol exec tsdown src/index.ts --dts && pnpm -r --filter @flux/daemon --filter @flux/relay exec tsdown src/index.ts --deps.alwaysBundle @flux/protocol && pnpm --filter @flux/pwa run build
